logo.description: Wordmark: large '20' (the '2' muted teal, the '0' bright cyan, overlapping) above lowercase 'scale' in muted teal. Placed on near-black navy.
logo.todo: Request a transparent-background SVG/PNG, a horizontal lockup and a square icon (favicon) version. Current file has the dark background baked in.

colors.note: background/primaryMuted sampled from logo; primary (cyan) estimated from the '0'. Confirm exact hex with the designer file.

theme.style: rich, majestic, minimal. Subtle cyan glow, thin borders, soft gradients, generous spacing. No clutter.

typography.latinHeading: Manrope or Outfit (geometric, wide, bold -- matches logo)
typography.sinhala: Noto Sans Sinhala (fallback: Iskoola Pota, system-ui)
typography.rule: Sinhala needs larger line-height (1.7+) than English. Never use letter-spacing on Sinhala text.

rules: Sinhala is primary: write natural spoken-professional Sinhala, mixed with English tech terms where Sri Lankan business owners use them (POS, stock, backup).
Never disparage competitors by name. Show transparency instead of attacking others.
Never claim what is not verified (see company.deliveredProjects).

motion.style: simple, subtle motion graphics that support the message, never distract
allowed: soft glow pulse on primary CTA
animated flow line for the 'process' section

ui.buttons: Primary = cyan fill, dark text. Secondary = outline.
ui.note: mobile-first assumed (most Sri Lankan visitors use phones) -- owner had no data.
